headline_marked: Storms and [[rain forecast for Dhaka]] and 9 other regions
headline: Storms and rain forecast for Dhaka and 9 other regions
summary: Thunderstorms and lightning are expected in the capital and several districts, with warnings issued for early afternoon.
details: Weather forecasts indicate a high probability of rain and thunderstorms in Dhaka and nine other regions across the country.
The warnings include risks of lightning strikes, urging residents to take necessary precautions.
Weather alerts suggest that these conditions are likely to manifest by 1:00 PM today.
People in the affected districts are advised to stay indoors and avoid open areas during the thunderstorm.

headline_marked: Former Chhatra League leader arrested after [[July Monument set on fire]] in Khagrachari
headline: Former Chhatra League leader arrested after July Monument set on fire in Khagrachari
summary: Attackers used petrol to set fire to the monument at Khagrachari Government College; police have detained a former district vice-president of the banned organization.
details: An attack was carried out on the July Monument located on the grounds of Khagrachari Government College on Friday night around 9 PM.
caption:
Petrol was used to set fire to the July Monument in Khagrachari on Friday night.
